_comment: Step 21's sensitive-path denylist — path segments/query keys strongly associated with a one-time, credential-bearing link (password reset, email verification, magic-link login, unsubscribe tokens). Matched case-insensitively against the path+query BEFORE the query-string policy strips the query, since the token itself often lives in the query. This list is a starting point, not exhaustive — expand it as real captures surface more patterns; it is deliberately conservative (biased toward over-matching, since dropping a normal reading is far cheaper than storing a live password-reset token).
